ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web/food chain relationship diagram, in which there are grass, insects, deer, birds, frogs, snakes, foxes/canids, raccoons, and the silhouette of a large feline animal in the upper left corner. The arrows point from the food or prey that is eaten to the animal that eats it. The large feline animal in the upper left corner is located at the highest place in the diagram, and there are arrows pointing to it. Reasoning: Following the direction of the arrows upward to trace the food chain, the highest-level predator is the animal that receives arrows from other animals but is not shown as being preyed on by other animals. The large feline animal in the upper left corner in the diagram is the highest-level predator, namely panther.
